companies.name: Start the shop
companies.plain_english: Java calls this method to start the Shopizer application. It hands startup over to Spring Boot.

companies.name: Check that the shop has started
companies.plain_english: When Spring Boot says the shop is ready, this method finds the current working folder and writes it to the application log.

inbound.name: Spring Boot ready event
inbound.description: Spring invokes this method for ApplicationReadyEvent; Company 1 does not call it directly.

outbound.name: Read working folder
outbound.description: System.getProperty("user.dir") reads the current working directory.

outbound.name: Write startup log
outbound.description: logger.info writes a message containing the working directory.

companies.name: Set up request filtering
companies.type: Spring Boot bean for XSS servlet filter registration
companies.plain_english: Registers a request filter for the shop, API, and customer URLs. It creates an XssFilter and tells Spring Boot which web requests should pass through it.

inbound.name: Spring creates the filter bean
inbound.description: The @Bean annotation lets Spring call this method while configuring the application.

outbound.name: Build filter registration
outbound.description: Creates a FilterRegistrationBean to connect the filter to web requests.

outbound.name: Shopizer XssFilter
outbound.description: Creates a real Shopizer XssFilter; its implementation has not been assigned a company number yet.

numbering_policy: IDs are permanent. Assign dotted subsidiary numbers only to verified parent/child methods; event-driven steps and external APIs are links, not automatic subsidiaries.
